channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: United Nations says US may have committed war crimes in Iran: What it means
item.description: UN probe finds US unlawfully struck an Iranian school and sports centre, killing children; White House rejects findings.

item.title: ‘My children did not attack Iran’: 2bn South Asians suffer from distant war
item.description: A quarter of the world’s population faces a surging cost of living crisis because of the wars in the Middle East.

item.title: Israel is killing the people who could end its wars
item.description: From Iran to Gaza and Lebanon, assassinations have repeatedly removed figures capable of negotiating an end to conflict.

item.title: Bayern and England’s Kane not focused on Ballon d’Or despite 73-goal season
item.description: Harry Kane could become first Ballon d'Or from England since 2001, but striker focused on Bayern Munich trophies.

item.title: Nigerian police probe death in custody of 37 illegal mining suspects
item.description: Officials blame disease outbreak for deaths as survivor suggests they suffocated.

item.title: UN mission alleges crimes against humanity in Iranian protest crackdown
item.description: A UN fact-finding mission has concluded Iranian forces committed crimes against humanity.

item.title: South Korea says US-North Korea talks possible, rules out Hormuz deployment
item.description: South Korean president will facilitate US-North Korea talks but will not deploy troops in US war on Iran.

item.title: Fire engulfs Zaporizhzhia shopping centre after Russian strike
item.description: A Russian strike hit a shopping centre in Zaporizhzhia, southeastern Ukraine, sparking a major fire.

item.title: At least 16 killed in attack on mosque in Pakistan
item.description: A vehicle loaded with explosives rammed into a mosque building during Friday prayers, a senior police official says.

item.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
item.description: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.
